events.title: Navigator Stretches Legs. Waldo Gets Parked.
events.thought: The Navigator and Another went up the L Trail while I sat in the lot at the trailhead — I'm told this counts as a rest day.
events.photoCaption: The Navigator descending the L Trail on Mount Sentinel above Missoula, MT, with the city spread out in the smoky haze of the valley below.

events.title: Southgate Inn. Missoula Night Two.
events.thought: Two nights in Missoula — the L Trail got hiked, smoke hung over the valley all day, and Southgate Inn is apparently where we're sleeping. Fine.
